duration_basis: Complete retained input acquisition and calculation; excludes final conditional publication

benefiting.basis: tonnage-weighted mean 7d-vs-28d change of 3 exposed ports (Port 0,Port 2,Port 1)
benefiting.name: Fixture industry

benefiting.basis: beta 0.500 (n=12) x shock 11.81 — OLS on archived factor history
benefiting.name: Fixture sector

impact_map.method: Industry rows: measured tonnage-weighted throughput change of ports carrying that PortWatch industry exposure. Sector rows: estimated from the accruing beta store (nightly factor history) — absent until n_obs>=8, honestly.

definitions.cohort: Each direction uses the identical registered, country-consistent ports with both windows complete. Imports and exports can have different cohorts; no combined world total is calculated.
definitions.coverage: Includes every provider catalog port and all unregistered observation IDs. Missing catalog ports remain visible. This catalog and matching query membership are not a world-port census or atomic provider snapshot.
definitions.interpretation: Descriptive estimated shipment weight. Not customs value, deflated trade volume, unique global cargo, a seasonally/holiday-adjusted change, a company earnings forecast or a portfolio instruction.
definitions.window: Exact seven calendar dates and immediately preceding 28 dates, ending at the explicit latest provider date. Every date and value required; no ragged-date trimming or missing-as-zero substitution.

method: IMF PortWatch Daily_Ports_Data (keyless ArcGIS): per-port daily estimated import/export cargo in METRIC TONS. 7d daily-rate vs prior-28d baseline per port; country + global rollups. Fields are schema-discovered each run, never assumed (ops-4559 BUG-11).
research_limits: Source query membership and the separate measurement_review reproduce exact dated shipment comparisons over matched port cohorts. Legacy fields retain their inherited missing-as-zero arithmetic, ragged trimming, seasonal alignment, name joins and unqualified impact models. Neither field set is a customs-value, company-revenue or portfolio forecast.

seasonal_baseline.method: current 7d tonnage vs mean of the SAME weekday-aligned 7d window 1-3 years back (364-day steps, server-side sums) — kills Chinese-New-Year / pre-tariff false signals the naive 28d baseline screams on
